newsitem.title: USA: Lyondell LCR unit's Q3 affected by problems.
newsitem.headline: Lyondell LCR unit's Q3 affected by problems.

text.p: Lyondell Petrochemical Co said Monday its LCR unit's results in the third quarter will be affected by operating problems that occurred in late June.
It is also seeing some weakening in the polymers business as it enters the third quarter and relatively stable product prices in petrochemicals.
The company said it expects to be back to full heavy crude oil processing rates by early August.
The company reported earnings per share for the second quarter of $1.17 compared with $0.19 for the same period a year ago.
The 1996 results were adjusted for the deconsolidation of financial results from Lyondell-Citgo Refining Co -- the LCR unit -- which was effective January 1, 1997.
It also said the operating problems of late June limited the full benefits to the LCR unit of its recently completed upgrade project.

Petrochemical operating income increased to $137 million compared to $83 million in the first quarter. It increased to $30 million from $16 million in the polymers unit, and $21 million compared with $6 million in the LCR unit.
